title: Degree-zero normalization of the unbounded right-derived single unit
statement: Let C,D be abelian categories with derived categories, enough injectives and K-injective resolutions in C. Let F:C→D be additive and left exact, and M∈C. Define u_F(M):F(M)[0]→RF(M[0]) as Q of the inverse single-complex comparison followed by the right-derived unit on the homotopy single complex. Let z_F(M):H⁰RF(M[0])≅F(M) be homologyRightDerivedFunctorObjSingleFunctorIso followed by rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf. Then H⁰(u_F(M))≫z_F(M).hom is the canonical singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso.hom on F(M).

source.place: Section 13.20, especially Lemma 13.20.4(2); the canonical augmentations in Mathlib and lem-sbc-right-derived-single-unit-homology-comparison.

proof.text: Transport rightDerivedPlusSingleUnitHomology_comp_comparison through rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility. The defining rightDerivedNatTrans_app equation carries the unbounded unit to the bounded-below unit. Cancel the single-object transport, and use naturality of homologyFunctorFactors to identify the source comparison. This gives the classical toRightDerivedZero augmentation.

Precompose with homology of Q applied to the inverse single-complex comparison. Naturality of homologyFunctorFactors moves this comparison to homology of complexes, where the inverse and forward single comparisons cancel. Cancel toRightDerivedZero with rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf.hom. The remaining map is exactly the canonical homology of a single complex. The calculation also applies to M=0 and the zero functor.

proof_origin.place: Section 13.20, especially Lemma 13.20.4(2); the canonical augmentations in Mathlib and lem-sbc-right-derived-single-unit-homology-comparison.

theorem rightDerivedSingleUnit_zero (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] (M : C) :
    (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor D 0).map (F.rightDerivedSingleUnit M) ≫
      (F.homologyRightDerivedFunctorObjSingleFunctorIso M 0 ≪≫
        F.rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf.app M).hom =
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso D 0).hom.app (F.obj M)
